# F0001 — Create item

Status: ready
Source: owner:demo, 2026-11-13

## Overview

A member creates items in a batch.

## Description

### Creating an item

The member enters names and saves. Names are required and must be unique. Batch
saving returns separate outcome counters. A busy worker can defer an item.

## Out of scope

- Editing an item.

## Decisions

| ID | Decision | Source | Status |
